liebermann.notes: Copied c. 1570 from Lambarde's printed edition (Ld), faithfully reproducing its decorations, notes, headings and errors. Behind Af El it adds a second prologue in Alfred's name mentioning Asser, which Liebermann judges spurious, probably a 16th-century invention to exalt Asser and Oxford.
